title: Point-of-Sale Points on the Replacement System Installations Accessory Member Discount
content:
# Point-of-sale points

The point-of-sale points of the accessory member discount on a Replacement System Installations contract compare the posting dates of the accessory charges on the contract with the contract's signing date:

| Accessory charges posted on the signing date | Points added |
|---|---|
| Every accessory charge on the contract | 2 percentage points |
| Some but not all | 1 percentage point |
| None | No point-of-sale points |

## Cases (hypothetical contracts signed on 2026-09-14)

- A surge protector and a media air cleaner, both charged on 2026-09-14: every charge on the signing date — 2 points.
- A surge protector charged on 2026-09-14 and a steam humidifier charged on 2026-09-22: some but not all — 1 point.
- A UV germicidal light charged on 2026-09-20 only: none on the signing date — no points.
- A single condensate pump charged on 2026-09-14: that one charge is every accessory charge — 2 points.
